review_candidates.description: About the Internship Applications are now open for the UneeQ Interns – October 2026 Cohort , a remote, task-based internship program designed for students, fresh graduates, and aspiring professionals looking to gain practical experience and build a strong, career-ready portfolio. The program focuses on hands-on learning through practical assignments and projects that allow interns to apply their knowledge, develop industry-relevant skills, and demonstrate their abilities through real project work. Available Internship Tracks Mobile App Development UI/UX Design Machine Learning & AI Web Development Content Creation Data Analysis Cybersecurity Cloud Computing Business Analysis What You Will Gain During the internship, participants will have the opportunity to: Work on practical, project-based assignments. Develop and strengthen technical and professional skills. Build a portfolio of projects to showcase to future employers. Gain practical experience that can be highlighted on your CV and LinkedIn profile. Receive guidance and support throughout the training experience. Earn an official certificate of completion upon successfully meeting the program requirements. Program Structure The UneeQ internship follows a flexible, task-oriented remote learning model . There are no mandatory daily live lectures. Instead, interns are given specific tasks and projects with defined requirements and deadlines. This structure allows participants to manage their time independently while developing important workplace skills such as: Time management Task prioritization Communication Attention to detail Independent problem-solving Meeting deadlines Professional responsibility Projects and assignments are reviewed based on their quality, completeness, and originality . Participants are expected to submit their own work and avoid copying or submitting unoriginal projects. Who Can Apply? The program is open to: Current college or university students Fresh graduates Individuals enrolled in training or educational programs Beginners who are looking to gain practical experience Aspiring professionals seeking to strengthen their portfolios General Requirements Applicants should have: Good organizational and time-management skills. Basic proficiency with digital tools and online collaboration platforms. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Strong attention to detail. The ability to learn new processes quickly. A proactive attitude toward learning and receiving feedback. Reliable internet access. A computer suitable for remote work. A high school diploma or current enrollment in a college, university, or training program is required. Previous internship or volunteer experience is a plus. Important Program Information Remote internship Flexible, task-based structure No complex interview process required Suitable for both beginners and more experienced learners Project quality and originality are important for successful completion Certificate awarded upon fulfilling the program requirements Why Join UneeQ Interns? This internship is designed to help you bridge the gap between learning and practical experience . Instead of only adding another course to your CV, you'll have the opportunity to work on projects, document your work, develop a portfolio, and demonstrate practical skills that can support your future career opportunities. How to Apply Ready to start building practical experience and strengthen your professional profile? Apply for the UneeQ Interns – October 2026 Cohort: https://www.uneeqinterns.com/internships Take the next step toward becoming career-ready.

review_candidates.title: Deloitte Innovation Hub I OMP Implementation Consultant, Cairo, Egypt
review_candidates.description: OMP Implementation Consultant, Cairo, Egypt Connect to your career at Deloitte. Deloitte, established globally in 1845, is the world’s largest and leading professional services firm, providing audit and assurance, tax, consulting, financial advisory, and risk advisory services to public and private clients spanning multiple industries. We are present in more than 150 countries, and as the world's largest management consulting business, Deloitte is distinct in its ability to help clients solve their most complex problems, from strategy to implementation. Deloitte Innovation Hub (DIH) is a strategic initiative to support our ambition to become the leading business transformation partner of choice for our clients and to expand and scale our delivery footprint across EMEA. With access to a scaled, diverse, highly skilled, motivated, and engaged workforce, DIH is delivering complex technical solutions for clients’ most complex business problems, across Portfolios that include ‘Strategy & Transactions’, ‘Customer’, ‘Engineering, AI & Data, ‘Enterprise, Technology & Performance’ and ‘Cyber’. DIH is aiming to become the destination for top talents in Egypt for a long, exciting career. We invest in outstanding people of diverse talents and backgrounds and empower them to achieve more than they could elsewhere. Our work combines advice with action and integrity. We believe that when our clients and society are stronger, so are we. Our organization has grown in scale and diversity, providing services across the region, with our shared culture remaining the same. We aim to help clients realize their ambitions, make a positive difference in society, and maximize the success of our people. This drive fuels the commitment and humanity that run deep through our every action. Connect to your opportunity. As An OMP Implementation Consultant, You Are eager and committed to develop Supply Chain Functional and Conceptual knowledge. Have a passion for innovative Supply Chain technology solutions driving a tangible impact for our clients in this digitally-enabled era Are determined to develop a deep understanding of OMP’s solutions, and you want to keep focus on OMP implementation projects (typically medium to long term projects, ranging from 6 months up to 3 years) Will Implement OMP Solutions From A To Z For Our Clients, Thereby Performing Hands-on Implementation Activities As Part Of a Bigger Implementation Team. Typical Activities Include Translating business needs into functional requirements and onwards into a working solution. Determining innovative ways to tackle the client’s business problem with OMP’s functionalities, in close collaboration with the Lead Solution Consultant, Solution Architect, and OMP Functional Experts. Solution parameterization and configuration. Writing macros (basic programming logic). Functional solution and integration testing. Data preparation and manipulation. Writing and facilitating end user solution training. Learning Opportunities For You Being part of a well-developed Supply Chain Planning team, well connected in the EMEA and Global supply chain network. Being exposed to end-to-end supply chain planning transformation programs, from Design to Implementation. Working for multinational organizations in diverse industries such as Consumer Business, Life Sciences, Chemicals, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, etc. Deepening your expertise in Supply Chain Management, and specifically in Planning and S&OP. You will learn how state-of-the-art technology platforms enable complex decision-making and facilitate management decisions. Gaining expertise and becoming proficient in a leading Advanced Supply Chain Planning Solution package, a key differentiating skill in today’s Talent market. Being offered plenty of career opportunities, in line with your ambitions. Growing into a Business Architect or Solution Architect, focusing on Project Management and/or Team and People Management are only a few of the options to grow in our organization. Connect To Your Skills And Professional Experience. We are looking for candidates with following qualifications: Very strong analytical skills. Preferably, you have a master's degree with a specialization in Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Optimization Techniques, Production Management, Logistics, or equivalent. Minimum 3 years of Experience. Theoretical or operational experience in Supply Chain Planning is a key asset (disciplines including Sales and Operations Planning / Integrated Business Planning, Demand Planning & Forecasting, Inventory Management & Optimization, Network Design, Network Supply Planning, Distribution Planning, Production Planning & Detailed Scheduling). Technology/Digital acumen and/or keen interest. Any prior APS (Advanced Planning System) exposure is an asset, either as an end-user, an implementation consultant, or product specialist. You are a team player, and you have an intellectual curiosity and drive to continuously learn. You are open to work in an international environment. You have strong communication skills, and you are fluent in English. Good knowledge of an additional language is an advantage. An APICS or other Supply Chain / Operations certificate is a plus. Open to hire professionals with experience in or motivation to develop expertise in other APS technologies (e.g. Anaplan, o9, JDA/BlueYonder, Kinaxis), as long as there is willingness and motivation to focus on OMP as well – in context of cross-APS resource pools. Profiles currently on OM Partners Payroll (any entity across the world) is off-limits! Connect to your service line - Consulting. Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters. Connect to your Industry. “What attracted me to Deloitte were the endless opportunities and the collective experience of other like-minded individuals. Deloitte’s clients include many of the world’s largest organizations; I wanted to be part of a team that made a difference that I could be proud of.” Dan, Consulting Personal independence . Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to several audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints. This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm. The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process. Connect to your agile working options. Your Work, Your Way: We call our hybrid working vision Deloitte Works. And it does. We trust you to make the right choices around where, when, and how you work. You’ll be able to make decisions about how you work best, to be collaborative, learn from colleagues, share your experiences, build the relationships that will fuel your career and prioritise your wellbeing. Having great conversations with your team and your leadership paves the way for great collaborative ways of working. Our commitment to you Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before. We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective, and personality. So, we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for. Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead. Connect to your next step. A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.

review_candidates.title: Senior Data Engineer, BI
review_candidates.description: Why join this team Design and deliver scalable OLTP, Business Intelligence, and Data Warehouse solutions using Microsoft Fabric, SSIS, SQL Server, and related BI technologies. Develop and maintain enterprise reports, support requirements gathering, evaluate and recommend technical approaches, and implement solutions within established timelines. This position is hybrid. NYC Salary range: $115,000 - $160,000 annually; compensation is commensurate to geographic location. What You'll Do Regardless of seniority or role, uphold UNFCU’s mission, core values, and guiding principles by providing an exceptional service experience to colleagues and members alike through consistent demonstration of our service excellence behaviors. Develop and maintain ETL/ELT processes using SSIS, Fabric Pipelines, and/or Azure Data Factory, including advanced Script Tasks (C# or VB.NET) to automate file operations and apply custom business logic. Develop and implement solutions in Microsoft PowerBI and Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse/Warehouse modeling, Dataflows Gen2, Pipelines, and Semantic Models; support the modernization of existing ETL and reporting assets into Fabric and Azure cloud-based frameworks. Design, develop, and optimize complex T-SQL stored procedures, functions, and database objects for high-volume OLTP and Data Warehouse environments, with expertise in transaction isolation levels, table hints, deadlocks, linked servers, OPENQUERY, triggers, and column-level encryption. Perform advanced database performance tuning, including execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, partitioning, and transaction optimization. Contribute to the design and enhancement of OLTP and OLAP data models, ensuring alignment with business, analytical, and performance requirements. Build and support integrations that consume or expose REST APIs, including testing, validation, and troubleshooting using Postman and related API tools. Create and govern dashboards and visual analytics in Power BI or Tableau, ensuring accuracy, compliance with governance standards, and proper alignment with semantic models. Verify and maintain data quality and integrity across the data warehouse, semantic models, dashboards, reports, and data extracts. Troubleshoot and resolve database, ETL, reporting, data quality, performance, capacity, replication, and distributed data issues; participate in incident resolution and root-cause remediation. Maintain thorough documentation, adhere to change control processes, and support regulatory, cybersecurity, and data protection compliance. Collaborate with Product Managers, Analysts, Engineers, and cross-functional teams to enhance BI and data platform capabilities. Stay current with industry trends and participate in relevant training, conferences, and professional development programs. Participate in Credit Union training and development programs. Perform additional responsibilities as assigned. Ensure compliance with federal and state laws and regulations and UNFCU’s Code of Ethics & Business Conduct. What We're Seeking Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science 6 years of experience in reports and data warehouse development 5 years software development experience on Microsoft BI Platform including, , MS SQL Server 4 years of experience in DB Development (OLTP) using MS SQL 2 years of experience in building Data Marts using dimensional models 2 years of experience in building Dashboards and KPI visualization on Power BI and/or Tableau Strong reporting and data warehouse development skills on issues that are complex and evaluative in nature where troubleshooting may call for referencing an advanced knowledge base Large data migration experience Hands on experience using Oracle What Makes You Stand Out Maintaining code/scripts in TFS for multiple environments Cloud technology like Microsoft Azure, MS Power BI and Microsoft Fabric. DBA activities like database backup and restore. Data extraction using API Handling data in XML Who We Are UNFCU is a global not-for-profit financial institution that serves the UN community. We are committed to providing peace of mind to our members and colleagues and strive to achieve service excellence in all that we do. The best part of UNFCU is the people. Those that choose to work with us often find personal fulfillment, professional growth and a purposeful culture. UNFCU is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. UNFCU prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by country, federal, state or local laws.
